symbols.name: transferFranchiseeOwnership
symbols.description:
Utility to execute a Franchisee Ownership Transfer when a franchise is sold.

1. Preserves old franchisee's account & historic activity by migrating their Auth/Firestore email 
   to their personal address (e.g., tanvi.hegde@mailplus.com.au) and recording the franchise ID in `historicalFranchiseeIds`.
2. Re-assigns the shared mailbox (e.g., alexandria@mailplus.com.au) to the new owner's user account linked to the franchise.
3. Updates the franchisee document's `currentOwnerUserId`, `linkedUserIds`, and `ownershipHistory`.

symbols.name: deactivateLocalMileAccessForLead
symbols.description:
Deactivates LocalMile access for a lead.
Checks for contacts with explicit LocalMile access ('accessToLocalMile === yes'),
LocalMile credentials (localMilePlusAuthLink or securityCode),
or any associated contact/lead email, and calls the LocalMile deactivation API
(proxied via /api/localmile/deactivate-account to prevent CORS issues).

symbols.name: processLpoCancellationCascade
symbols.description:
Handles cascading cancellation for LPO Network customers:
1. Cancels all child leads and companies linked to the parent.
2. Marks linked lpo_leads documents as 'Lost' / 'Disabled'.
3. Disables LPO.Plus application user access (Auth & lpoconnect DB).
symbols.returnType: Promise<{ success: boolean; updatedChildCount: number; updatedLpoCount: number }>
